scientific_question: At equal full-field additive energy, where is the replicated neural-minus-posterior additive allocation difference located, and which locations exactly carry the replicated neural-norm Q_shape probability-slope reduction?
current_theory: P_T-dependent g_N carries the within-neural distance slope. Across seeds 2104 through 2107, the comparator-relative field fingerprint A>0, Q_shape>0, and I<0 is stable, but neither g_N nor c_N alone is sufficient and R remains unresolved. The next admissible step is localization of the equal-energy additive allocation difference, not a model intervention.
audit_hypothesis: A structural or subject-state allocation fingerprint may be stable across the two fresh backbones on one or more of four frozen axes: residual pair identity, symbolic distance, posterior uncertainty, and effective-admission coverage. An exact probability-slope bridge must distinguish field structure that carries Q_shape from field structure that is ineffective at the fixed sigmoid operating point.
claim_boundary: This is a sequential read-only localization on the already evaluated seed-2106 and seed-2107 backbones. It does not provide another independent replication, network-population prevalence, a component-sufficiency result, comparator truth, a causal P_T-internal mechanism, a realizable recurrent hybrid, or authorization for a model intervention. Posterior uncertainty is comparator-derived; an association with it cannot be described as incorrect neural uncertainty coding.
registration_timing: Frozen after the complete committed fingerprint replication result at 0fb40d1 and before writing an allocation-audit runner, loading either checkpoint for this audit, calculating any seed-2106/2107 Delta_g, Delta_p, q, pair vector, distance vector, or U/C coefficient, or inspecting any allocation outcome.

artifact_contract.artifact_source: Reuse exactly the two backbone artifact sets in the frozen fingerprint artifact lock; create no checkpoint, gain, transformed artifact, cache, or new artifact lock.
artifact_contract.fingerprint_prerequisite: The frozen fingerprint result must retain outcome replicated_field_fingerprint; both seed qualification and integrity records must pass; and no participant or network pooling may have occurred.

runtime_contract.device: visible CUDA GPU required for neural replay
runtime_contract.command: direnv exec . python -m fsrl.formal_runtime global-policy-allocation-audit evaluate
runtime_contract.replay: A second complete evaluation may write only one explicit result file below /tmp and must be byte-compared with the canonical result.

field_contract.construction: Recompute the unchanged complete-graph neural and exact-posterior margins and call the source-locked field_reassembly_estimands implementation. Use its g_N, c_N, g_P_tilde, NN probability, tildePN probability, Q_shape, edge order, sign, mask, distances, norm match, and fixed sigmoid without alteration.
field_contract.edge_order: All 28 unordered pairs in lexicographic integer order; the analysis subset is the same fixed 20 nonlearned pairs.
field_contract.norm_match: g_P_tilde=g_P*||g_N||_2/||g_P||_2 separately within participant, using all 28 canonical edges before correctness signing or nonlearned selection.
field_contract.excluded_variants: No alternative norm, reverse norm match, learned-pair subset, orientation, temperature, residual, comparator, mask, clipping, ranking, or transformed Delta_g is admissible.

exact_probability_slope_bridge.orientation_clarification: To preserve the existing Q_shape estimand, Delta_p is a difference of correctness-oriented probabilities. The same expression without y is not an admissible bridge estimand.
exact_probability_slope_bridge.fixed_nonlearned_design: For the 20 nonlearned pairs, d_bar is their unweighted mean symbolic distance, exactly 2.8, and V_d=sum_e(d[e]-d_bar)^2, exactly 57.2.
exact_probability_slope_bridge.exact_identity: sum_e q[s,e]=Q_shape[s] separately for every participant; the same identity must hold in every participant-bootstrap draw.
exact_probability_slope_bridge.interpretation: Delta_g localizes equal-energy pre-sigmoid additive allocation. q localizes the exact contribution of the resulting fixed-sigmoid probability difference to the replicated Q_shape slope reduction. A large Delta_g with negligible or unstable q is not policy-effective evidence for this fingerprint.

pair_identity.field_vector: mu_delta[e]=mean_s delta[s,e] over the 20 fixed nonlearned pairs.
pair_identity.bridge_vectors: mu_Delta_p[e]=mean_s Delta_p[s,e] and the exact ledger mu_q[e]=mean_s q[s,e] over the same pairs.
pair_identity.distance_removal: Fit mu_delta[e]=alpha_delta+beta_delta*d[e]+r_delta[e] and mu_Delta_p[e]=alpha_p+beta_p*d[e]+r_Delta_p[e] by unweighted OLS across the 20 pairs. Define the distance-residualized exact contribution r_q[e]=((d[e]-d_bar)/V_d)*r_Delta_p[e], equivalently mu_q minus the q ledger predicted by alpha_p+beta_p*d. This avoids converting a purely linear distance effect in Delta_p into a spurious quadratic pair fingerprint. No polynomial, categorical distance effect, weighting, direct linear residualization of mu_q, or alternative residualization is allowed.
pair_identity.cross_network_metrics: Report raw mu_delta, mu_Delta_p, and mu_q correlations diagnostically. The registered field metric is Pearson correlation between seed-2106 and seed-2107 r_delta vectors; the registered bridge metric is the analogous r_q correlation.
pair_identity.bootstrap: For each independently seeded participant-bootstrap draw in each network, recompute the mean vectors, refit both linear distance models, construct r_delta and r_q, and correlate draw k from seed 2106 with draw k from seed 2107. The two count matrices are independently generated and participants are never pooled.
pair_identity.degeneracy: Pearson correlation is defined only when both centered vectors have strictly positive squared norm. If either centered residual vector has zero norm in a point estimate or draw, retain and report the degeneracy; the corresponding correlation is unresolved_degenerate rather than dropping pairs or changing the metric.

symbolic_distance.field_metric: Within each participant, use the same frozen closed form beta_delta_distance[s]=sum_e((d[e]-2.8)/57.2)*delta[s,e] over the 20 nonlearned pairs; summarize its cohort mean separately within each network.
symbolic_distance.bridge_vector: Q_by_distance[s,d]=sum_{e:distance[e]=d}q[s,e] for the six frozen distance levels. The six entries sum to Q_shape[s].
symbolic_distance.cross_network_metric: Pearson correlation between the seed-2106 and seed-2107 cohort-mean six-level Q_by_distance vectors, with the same independent product-bootstrap pairing rule. Correlation requires strictly positive centered squared norm in both vectors; otherwise retain unresolved_degenerate without dropping a distance level.
symbolic_distance.reporting: Report every distance-level contribution and interval. Do not select or test a post-hoc near, middle, far, argmax, merged-bin, or contribution-share contrast.

posterior_uncertainty.definition: U[s]=H[P_post(pi|D_s)]/log(8!) from the complete frozen exact-order posterior. This is the only uncertainty definition; P_post avoids overloading the pair-contribution symbol q.
posterior_uncertainty.boundary: U is derived from the same comparator that supplies g_P_tilde. A stable U association is comparator-relative organization, not independent evidence that the neural network mis-encodes uncertainty.

effective_evidence_coverage.definition: C[s]=(1/8)*sum_r z_sr over the eight unique support relations, where z_sr is the existing binary stable global-admission value. This is the only coverage definition.
effective_evidence_coverage.excluded_variants: No reliability magnitude, p_sr, trial count, raw exposure, graph connectivity, local-admission, or post-hoc coverage definition is allowed.

joint_uncertainty_coverage_model.standardization: Center U and C once over the full 77-participant cohort and divide by the ddof=0 population standard deviation sd(x)=sqrt(mean_s[(x_s-mean_s x)^2]). The same frozen full-cohort predictors are used in every point and bootstrap fit, are never restandardized within a draw, and must be identical across networks.
joint_uncertainty_coverage_model.fit: Ordinary least squares over all 77x20 rows with exactly 20 pair dummy columns, no additional intercept, and the two simultaneous predictors, for design rank 22. Participant bootstrap resamples the complete 20-row block and refits all fixed effects and both coefficients.
joint_uncertainty_coverage_model.solver: Exploit the exact balanced-design identity: the two predictor coefficients equal OLS coefficients from the participant mean response on [1,U_z,C_z]. Solve the 3x3 normal equations with numpy.linalg.solve, never pinv, ridge, draw deletion, or predictor deletion. The reduced design must have rank 3 in the point estimate and every bootstrap draw, which is equivalent here to full pair-FE design rank 22. Verify the point coefficients against the explicit 1540x22 dummy design within 1e-10.
joint_uncertainty_coverage_model.identity: Because the design is balanced, 20*beta_q_U and 20*beta_q_C must equal the coefficients from Q_shape[s]=alpha+beta_Q_U*U_z[s]+beta_Q_C*C_z[s]+error separately in the point estimate and every bootstrap draw within 1e-10.
joint_uncertainty_coverage_model.forbidden_terms: No U-by-C, distance-by-U, distance-by-C, pair-by-predictor, nonlinear, thresholded, transformed, univariate, stepwise, or post-hoc term may be added or substituted.

statistical_contract.unit: participant within network; pair and distance labels are fixed and never resampled
statistical_contract.within_network_rule: For scalar slopes and U/C coefficients, resolved_positive requires lower95>0, resolved_negative requires upper95<0, and otherwise the result is unresolved. No equivalence or materiality margin is defined.
statistical_contract.cross_network_correlation_rule: resolved_positive requires lower95>0, resolved_negative requires upper95<0, unresolved spans zero, and unresolved_degenerate records any undefined point metric or nonfinite bootstrap draw. No absolute-correlation cutoff, equivalence rule, p-value, or alternate similarity measure is allowed.
statistical_contract.stable_direction_rule: A scalar field or bridge coefficient has stable direction only when it is resolved in the same nonzero direction separately in both networks.
statistical_contract.no_pooling: Generate and retain one count matrix per network from its registered seed. Never concatenate participant rows, average network estimates before inference, pool bootstrap draws, resample networks, or claim network-population prevalence. Corresponding independently generated bootstrap draw indices may be paired only to form the two registered cross-network vector correlations.
statistical_contract.multiplicity_boundary: The four axes are a fixed developmental localization family. Report every field and bridge metric regardless of outcome. No family-wise error control or minimum-effect claim is made; policy_effective means only directionally stable exact-bridge localization under this frozen developmental rule. The outcome tree requires cross-network stability and does not license axis selection, confirmatory population inference, or an unregistered fifth axis.

pair_identity.field_stable: The registered distance-residualized mu_delta correlation is resolved_positive.
pair_identity.bridge_stable: The registered r_q correlation, constructed from distance-residualized mu_Delta_p, is resolved_positive.

symbolic_distance.field_stable: The participant delta-distance slope has the same resolved nonzero direction separately in both networks.
symbolic_distance.bridge_stable: The registered six-level Q_by_distance correlation is resolved_positive.

posterior_uncertainty.field_stable: beta_delta_U has the same resolved nonzero direction separately in both networks.
posterior_uncertainty.bridge_stable: beta_q_U has the same resolved nonzero direction separately in both networks.
posterior_uncertainty.policy_effective: Both statuses are stable and beta_delta_U and beta_q_U have the same direction.

effective_evidence_coverage.field_stable: beta_delta_C has the same resolved nonzero direction separately in both networks.
effective_evidence_coverage.bridge_stable: beta_q_C has the same resolved nonzero direction separately in both networks.
effective_evidence_coverage.policy_effective: Both statuses are stable and beta_delta_C and beta_q_C have the same direction.

outcome_tree.noninterpretable_integrity_failure: Any source, artifact, runtime, prerequisite, checkpoint, completeness, finiteness, norm-match, probability reconstruction, Q_shape replay, q identity, predictor-definition, predictor-rank, or tensor-immutability gate fails.
outcome_tree.policy_effective_allocation_localized: After all gates pass, at least one of the four frozen axes is policy_effective. Record localization_scope as state_dependent when U and/or C qualifies, structural_only when only pair identity and/or symbolic distance qualifies, and both when both axis classes qualify. A new prospective P_T-generation question is permitted only for state_dependent or both. Structural_only preserves the positive localization but redirects next to comparator adequacy, with no further neural decomposition or intervention.
outcome_tree.field_structure_without_policy_bridge: After all gates pass, no axis is policy_effective but at least one axis is field_stable or bridge_stable, including a stable opposite-direction U/C mapping. Preserve all field-only, bridge-only, and opposite-direction structure, conclude that no concordant state-dependent axis stably links Delta_g structure to Q_shape through the exact bridge, and redirect next to comparator adequacy without a P_T intervention or further neural decomposition.
outcome_tree.no_stable_allocation_localization: After all gates pass, none of the four axes is field_stable and none is bridge_stable. Turn next to a separately prospective comparator-adequacy test; do not add features, interactions, thresholds, or neural parameter audits.
outcome_tree.priority: Apply integrity first, then classify all four axes, then apply the three scientific outcomes. Always report bridge-only, opposite-direction, unresolved, and degenerate metrics without allowing them to override the tree.

competence_and_integrity_gates.source_and_artifact_hashes: All registered sources, the new implementation lock, the original joint artifact lock, and all eight original artifact files must match SHA-256.
competence_and_integrity_gates.formal_runtime: Visible GPU with one PyTorch intra-op and one inter-op CPU thread.
competence_and_integrity_gates.fingerprint_prerequisite: The hash-locked prior result has replicated_field_fingerprint, both qualifications and integrities pass, source_validation and artifact_validation pass, and network_population_inference is not_performed.
competence_and_integrity_gates.frozen_parameters: Every loaded backbone tensor hash is identical before and after evaluation.
competence_and_integrity_gates.complete_execution: Exactly seeds 2106 and 2107, all 77 participants, 28 canonical edges, the fixed 20 nonlearned pairs, all six registered distance levels, and all 10000 bootstrap draws per network.
competence_and_integrity_gates.field_replay: Recomputed participant-level Q_shape exactly matches the prior result and the recomputed field/probability/norm-match integrity quantities pass within 1e-10.
competence_and_integrity_gates.bridge_identity: Delta_p equals NN-minus-tildePN probability participant-by-pair; q sums to Q_shape participant-wise and bootstrap-wise; Q_by_distance sums to q and Q_shape; tolerance 1e-10.
competence_and_integrity_gates.predictors: U and C match their frozen definitions, are finite, have nonzero variance, are identical across the two network replays, and the simultaneous standardized design has full rank. The observed strong association between U and C may widen intervals but does not permit dropping either predictor.
competence_and_integrity_gates.joint_model_rank_and_identity: The point and every bootstrap draw have reduced rank 3/full pair-FE rank 22; the explicit point pair-FE solution, balanced-design reduction, and point/draw 20-times-q coefficient identities all pass within 1e-10.
competence_and_integrity_gates.correlations: Any zero-norm vector is retained as an axis degeneracy. All otherwise defined point and bootstrap metrics must be finite; no draw may be silently discarded.
competence_and_integrity_gates.no_filtering_or_posthoc_repair: No participant, pair, distance, network, axis, predictor, field component, bootstrap draw, comparator, threshold, interaction, or outcome may be removed, replaced, added, or redefined after execution.

execution_firewall.implementation_freeze: Commit and push the runner, tests, formal-runtime dispatch, and exact implementation/source lock before either checkpoint is loaded for this audit.
execution_firewall.read_only: No training, adaptation, optimization, cache generation, checkpoint write, gain, local trace, recurrent intervention, readout change, temperature change, or artifact mutation is allowed.
execution_firewall.one_command_both_networks: Evaluate both mandatory networks in one command. An outcome or failure in seed 2106 cannot remove, replace, redefine, or condition execution of seed 2107 except that an unknown software exception fails the command hard.
execution_firewall.prior_networks: Seeds 2104 and 2105 are provenance only and may not enter any allocation vector, fit, threshold, or outcome decision.
execution_firewall.result_path: Write the canonical result once. Refuse overwrite. Permit only an evaluate-time /tmp file override for the complete byte-replay.
execution_firewall.git_gate: Evaluation requires clean dev with HEAD equal to origin/dev and the specification and implementation lock tracked and byte-identical to HEAD.
execution_firewall.implementation_lock_content: The new lock must bind the exact specification SHA-256; the new runner, runner tests, updated formal runtime, and updated formal-runtime tests; every reused scientific source; and the upstream fingerprint specification, implementation lock, artifact lock, result, report, output root, and exact checkpoint hashes. It must not modify or supersede the upstream lock or training manifests.
execution_firewall.required_result_raw_arrays: For each network retain separate participant-level Delta_g canonical nonlearned rows, correct-signed delta rows, Delta_p rows, q rows, Q_by_distance rows, U, C, delta-distance slopes, recomputed Q_shape, and prior Q_shape anchors; retain pair/distance vectors, model coefficients, all intervals, statuses, integrity values, and cross-network correlations without any pooled raw array.
execution_firewall.repair_boundary: Only an integrity or execution repair that leaves every field, bridge, axis, predictor, bootstrap, status, and outcome definition unchanged is admissible; it must be documented and refrozen before replay.

outcome_contingent_interpretation.policy_effective_allocation_localized: Report every stable and unstable axis and the frozen localization_scope. A policy-effective axis is a directionally stable developmental exact-bridge localization, not a minimum-effect or family-wise-error-controlled claim. It localizes where equal-energy additive allocation differs and where that difference carries Q_shape at the frozen sigmoid operating point. Only U/C localization may justify a prospective state-dependent P_T-generation question. Pair/distance-only localization is preserved but redirects next to comparator adequacy. No scope justifies an immediate intervention or sufficiency claim.
outcome_contingent_interpretation.field_structure_without_policy_bridge: Preserve field-only, bridge-only, and stable opposite-direction results. The registered axes do not supply a concordant state-dependent Delta_g-to-Q_shape localization, so redirect next to comparator adequacy and do not target that structure inside P_T.
outcome_contingent_interpretation.no_stable_allocation_localization: The four admissible axes do not localize a stable cross-network Delta_g fingerprint. Preserve Q_shape and the full field fingerprint, but redirect to comparator adequacy rather than feature engineering or neural parameter decomposition.
outcome_contingent_interpretation.posterior_uncertainty_boundary: Any beta_U is a conditional pair-invariant association in the frozen joint model and organization relative to the frozen exact posterior, not a total effect, mediator, proof of incorrect uncertainty coding, or proof of a human posterior.
outcome_contingent_interpretation.coverage_boundary: Any beta_C is a conditional pair-invariant association in the frozen joint model, not a total effect, mediator, randomized causal effect, or proof that coverage uniquely generates g_N.
outcome_contingent_interpretation.model_scope_boundary: Failure of the no-interaction joint model rules out only the registered pair-invariant U/C main-effect localization. It does not establish absence of pair-conditioned or nonlinear state dependence. Pair residualization removes only a linear symbolic-distance component and cannot be described as removing categorical or nonlinear distance structure.
